name: Boom Deck
hook: Draw a card. Pray it isn't a Boom.
how: Play action cards, then draw one to end your turn. Draw a Boom and you're out, unless you have a Defuse: then you secretly slip the Boom back into the deck. Peek, Skip, Attack, Shuffle and Steal to dodge it. Last one standing wins.
controls: Click or tap a card to play it, tap the deck to draw
uses: Your hand, your peeks and where you hide a Boom are sealed so only you can read them (the host deals, so it can too).
The host's browser shuffles, deals and checks every card; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill empty seats, peek, steal and dodge, and take over for anyone who leaves.
Games won, shown after every game.
ideas: Add a Reverse card that changes the turn order
Put two Booms in the deck for every player
Make it a pirate ship with powder kegs instead of bombs
